profile.name: Yashvi Poojari
profile.tagline: I build reliable applications, translate requirements into practical technical solutions, and solve problems across the software development lifecycle.
profile.specialization: Application Development · Software Engineering · Data & Cloud
profile.bio: I'm a Computer Science & Business Systems undergraduate at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology with an 8.81 CGPA, focused on application development, software engineering, data-driven solutions, and cloud technologies. I build practical applications using Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL, React, Streamlit, FastAPI, and AWS fundamentals. I enjoy understanding requirements, translating them into functional solutions, testing and debugging applications, documenting technical work, and collaborating with teams to deliver projects within deadlines. SIH'24 National Finalist and AWS Cloud Foundations certified, with a strong interest in building reliable, maintainable and user-focused applications.
